title: FileSendNX
tagline: Secure file transfer so you can upload, share and track without friction

problem.title: The problem
problem.body: Consultants and small teams needed a way to move sensitive files between clients without enterprise file-sharing contracts, messy email attachments or links that expire without notice. Existing tools were either too heavy, too expensive or too opaque for everyday use.

approach.title: How I approached it
approach.body: I built FileSendNX as a mobile-first transfer app with a clear upload, share and track flow. People pick files from their device, generate a secure link or direct handoff and see delivery status in one place.

technologies.title: Technologies
items: React Native + TypeScript for iOS and Android
Secure upload pipeline with progress and retry
Typed API layer and structured error handling
Polished mobile UI with accessibility in mind

outcome.title: Outcome
outcome.body: FileSendNX is a mobile app for transfers. The flow stays simple for non-technical users and the codebase is documented for later work.
